title: Pub trivia
note: Teams of up to six. Winners drink free for a round, losers pick next week's categories.

title: Growler fill night
note: Two dollars off every growler and crowler fill, any beer on the board.

title: Vinyl night
note: Bring a record, we'll spin it. One side per person, no skipping.

title: Food truck & nitro
note: A different truck out front every week, and Low Light pours on nitro.

title: Brewery tour
note: Forty minutes through the brewhouse with the brewer, a taster at every tank. $15.
